ngrok is a tool that allows you to expose a local development server to the internet. It creates a secure tunnel from a public URL to your local machine, allowing you to share your local development environment with others or access it remotely. This can be useful for testing, development, and collaboration purposes, as it allows you to easily share your local server with others without having to worry about security or port forwarding.

To use ngrok, you simply need to run the ngrok command, and it will generate a unique URL that you can use to access your local development environment. You can then share this URL with others, and they can access your server by visiting the URL in their browser.

ngrok is available for Mac, Windows, and Linux, and it can be used with a variety of web and mobile development tools, such as web servers, databases, and APIs.
